_about: Words tools/check_story_vocab.py raised and a person reviewed as right for the story. 'from' is the lowest level the word was approved at: a use at a lower level is raised again. Notes starting 'check:' are approved but worth a native speaker's second look. See story-writing-guide.md §5a.
